question: Who wrote the famous novel "Durgeshnandini"?
solution:
The correct answer is Bankim Chandra Chatterjee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bankim Chandra Chatterjee is the author of "Durgeshnandini".
 
• "Vande Mataram" was written by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee.
 
 
• It was first composed in the Sanskrit language in the year of 1870s (1875). Later in 1882, it was included in the Bengali novel Anandamath.
 
 
 
• Other notable works of Bankim Chandra Chatterjee:
 
 
• Anandmath, Kapalkundala, Komalakanter Doptor, Mrinalini, Krishnakanter Will, Bishbrikhsha, Rajsingho, Sitaram, Devi Chaudhurani.
